about:
Integrity Energy is based in East Bethel, Vermont. Founded in 2011 by Amos Post, a former lead installer and project manager at groSolar with nine years of experience, the company began with a focus on solar photovoltaic and solar thermal installations. Post earned NABCEP PV Installation Professional certification in 2009. In 2013, John Mattern, who had worked alongside Post at groSolar and brought 15 years of carpentry experience, became a co-owner.

The company designs, installs, and services grid-tied solar PV systems, grid-tied systems with battery backup, off-grid systems, and domestic solar hot water systems. As of the latest information, Integrity Energy has installed over 3 megawatts of photovoltaic capacity across residences and small businesses in Vermont and New Hampshire. The team includes three named members: Amos Post (founder/co-owner), John Mattern (co-owner), and David Mattern (installer/IT design), who joined in 2014.

Integrity Energy serves residential homeowners and small commercial clients throughout Vermont and New Hampshire. The company works with local financial institutions such as VSECU and Mascoma Bank to offer financing options. Typical residential system costs range from $20,000 to $30,000 before federal tax incentives, with a payback period of 10 to 12 years.

The company emphasizes high workmanship, polite efficiency, and delivering quality installations at reasonable prices. Its founders' background at groSolar and NABCEP certification underpin its technical credibility.
